title: Art. 2.24.1.1 — Annex 11 - Air Traffic Services, Chapter 2 - General, 2.24 Service to aircraft in the event of an emergency, 2.24.1.1
content:
Recommendation. In communications between ATS units and aircraft in the event of an emergency, Human Factors principles should be observed.

Note. Guidance material on Human Factors principles can be found in the Human Factors Training Manual (Doc 9683).
